name: MATE
description: Mate is a traditional Italian fishing card game played with a 40-card Italian deck. Players capture cards from a central layout by matching values, with special scoring for capturing the 'Mate' cards (Kings). It is a game of memory and timing, where players must remember which cards have been played to maximize their captures.

content.text: Mate is a traditional Italian fishing card game played with a 40-card Italian deck. Players capture cards from a central layout by matching values, with special scoring for capturing the 'Mate' cards (Kings). It is a game of memory and timing, where players must remember which cards have been played to maximize their captures.
Originating in Italy, Mate belongs to the family of fishing games popular throughout the Mediterranean. It shares mechanics with Scopa and other Italian card games.
40-card Italian deck (remove 8s, 9s, 10s from standard deck). Suits: Coins, Cups, Swords, Clubs. Ranking: King (highest), Queen, Jack, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, Ace (lowest).
40-card Italian deck or modified standard deck.
4 cards to each player and 4 cards face-up to the table. Remaining cards form the stock.

items.text: Mate with Combinations: Allow capturing multiple cards that sum to the played card's value.
Team Mate: 4 players in partnerships, combining captured cards with partner.
